name: ot_qkh_lane8_nc32c-g1-COMMIT
purpose: KV-PARAMS4 10-20 safe32 successor of ot_qkh_lane8 (Codex NC32C R7 + R8 bypass-bank select copies): mapped native census PASS max32 (results/rtl/kv_qkh_nc_safe32_1020/lane32_r8_summary.json). Same ports / pin faces / latency; outline 129.6 sq -> 172.8 sq (synth 13975 um2 = 83% in the old slot).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qkh_lane8_nc32c #(.ADD_LAT(7), .LTW(12)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_lane8_nc32c.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_subtiles.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_nearhbm_prod.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay_bounded32.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_qkh_ncr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv physical/ref_tile/ot_qkh_ktree_m5/src/rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/ot_qkh_lane8_nc32c/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/ot_qkh_lane8_nc32c/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/ot_qkh_lane8_nc32c --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qkh_lane8_nc32c  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
